app.title: Exoplanet Transit Classifier (Dash dashboard)
app.summary: A person opens a dashboard over a collection of candidates that a trained classifier has already labelled and scored. They read totals and distributions of the predicted classes and of model confidence, then look at the highest-ranked candidates in bar charts and a scatter of confidence against priority score. They sort and filter a ranking table, search for one candidate to see its prediction, measured properties, a star rating, plain-language notes and its folded signal curves at two scales, and check the model's evaluation curves. They leave with the full ranking downloaded as a CSV file of follow-up targets.

task.text: Find out which classifier-flagged candidates most deserve follow-up by browsing the model's ranked predictions, inspecting single candidates' signals and properties, and exporting the ranking.

data.text: A table of candidates with a model prediction, confidence, priority score and measured signal properties, plus a phase-folded brightness curve for each candidate at a full-orbit and a zoomed scale.
data.item: a candidate signal: one star's folded light curve with its predicted class and properties

stage.text: reviewing a trained classifier's ranked candidates to choose follow-up targets

mechanism.text: A long dashboard page stacks summary numbers, distribution charts and priority rankings over the whole set above a sortable, filterable table. Below them, a searchable dropdown picks one candidate and redraws a detail panel of property cards, rule-based notes and two linked curve plots. Static evaluation plots and a CSV download finish the page.

field.text: deep-learning classification of transit signals in light curves, in exoplanet astronomy

workflow.name: rank model-classified candidates and export a follow-up shortlist

steps.step: look over every item at a glance
steps.here: Cards count all samples, predicted planets and predicted false positives, and give the model's ROC-AUC. A metric bar chart, a class pie and a confidence histogram cover the whole set.

Bar charts of the highest priority scores and a horizontal top-10 coloured by class show period, duration, depth and SNR on hover. A scatter plots confidence against priority score for every candidate.

steps.step: filter to the items that matter
steps.here: The ranking table of the top 20 has native per-column sort and filter boxes.

A searchable dropdown picks a candidate file. The model runs on it and shows prediction, confidence, a score out of 100 with a star rating, SNR, period, duration and depth, plus threshold-based plain-language insights.
The full-orbit folded curve and the zoomed curve centred on the transit are drawn side by side.

steps.step: check how far the model can be trusted
steps.here: A confusion matrix, an ROC curve and a precision-recall curve from the evaluation run are shown as images.
A button downloads the full ranked-candidates CSV.

distinctive: Each candidate's signal is shown at two scales, the whole folded orbit and a window zoomed on the transit, which are the same two inputs the classifier sees.
Candidates are ranked by a priority score that mixes model confidence with signal-to-noise and transit depth, not by confidence alone.
The detail panel turns fixed thresholds on SNR, depth, duration, period and score into plain-language notes and a star rating that recommend whether to follow up.
The model's own evaluation curves sit on the same page, so the predictions can be weighed against how reliable the classifier is.

parts.title: Dataset and model overview
parts.summary: Shows counts of samples and predicted classes, the model's headline metrics, the class split and the spread of model confidence over the whole set.

parts.title: Priority rankings and confidence-vs-score scatter
parts.summary: Ranks the highest-priority candidates in bar charts that show their transit properties on hover, and plots every candidate's confidence against its priority score.

parts.title: Candidate rankings table and CSV download
parts.summary: Lists the top-ranked candidates in a table you can sort and filter, with a button that downloads the full ranking as a CSV.

parts.title: Candidate Explorer
parts.summary: A searchable dropdown picks one candidate, runs the classifier on it and redraws its summary and curves.

parts.title: Prediction summary and model insights
parts.summary: Shows the chosen candidate's predicted class, confidence, priority score with a star rating and its transit properties as cards, followed by threshold-based plain-language notes on whether to follow it up.

parts.title: Global and zoomed transit curves
parts.summary: Draws the chosen candidate's phase-folded light curve over the whole orbit beside a zoomed view centred on the transit.

parts.title: Model Performance Evaluation
parts.summary: Shows the classifier's confusion matrix, ROC curve and precision-recall curve so the person can judge how far to trust its predictions.
